extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings (acting for respondent in divorce)
extracted.summary: A family solicitor enquires on behalf of a divorce respondent about a £9,000 litigation loan for counsel, a forensic accountant and legal costs, with around £167,000 of assets in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry to Lodestar Legal Finance regarding funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £9,000 requested and the approximately £167,000 of assets in dispute comprising property and pensions. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, your client's details and a breakdown of the costs to be funded, along with information on the nature and ownership of the assets in dispute. We will send our criteria and application form for your review. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication that funding will be offered or on what terms.
